description: Thunderbird's calendars for Voice Companion's Calendar screen: list calendars and events, add, change and delete events. Times are milliseconds since 1970 (UTC); all-day dates are YYYY-MM-DD.

functions.name: listCalendars
functions.description: The calendars that are turned on. Resolves to [{id, name, type, readOnly, account}], or null when the calendar is not available. account is the email address the calendar belongs to, or '' when it is kept on this computer or not known.

functions.name: describeAddressBooks
functions.description: The email account of each address book. Resolves to [{id, account}], or null. account is '' for a book kept on this computer or when it is not known.

functions.name: listEvents
functions.description: Events from startMs to endMs in every calendar that is turned on, repeating events expanded. Resolves to {events, failed}, or null.

functions.name: createEvent
functions.description: Add one event. Resolves to {created, id} or {created: false, reason}.

functions.name: deleteEvent
functions.description: Delete an event, or one day of a repeating event (occurrence) unless all is true. Resolves to {deleted, all} or {deleted: false, reason}.

functions.name: modifyEvent
functions.description: Change an event, one day of a repeating event (occurrence), or all of them (all). changes holds only what changes; shift and length (minutes) are for a whole repeating event; calendarId moves the event. Resolves to {modified, id} or {modified: false, reason}.
